notes.title: UPDATE 0.1
notes.notes:
[b]Update 0.1 Patch Notes[/b]

In this update, we focused on addressing some major bugs that were causing frustration among players. We’ve also made some design changes. Overall, this update is primarily aimed at fixing important issues.

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

[olist]
[*] Fixed the issue where the Cashier NPC would freeze
[*] Fixed the issue where customers would get stuck in line
[*] Resolved the end-of-day error
[*] Price tags have been corrected
[*] Fixed the issue with medicines getting mixed up on shelves
[*] Corrected product names
[*] Fixed translation errors
[/olist]

NEW SAVE SYSTEM 
We’ve replaced the old local save system with Steam Cloud saves. This eliminates the issue of lost save files.

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]

[olist]
[*] You can now carry up to 3 medicines at once.
[*] The main menu has been completely redesigned.
[*] Computer interfaces have been updated and redesigned.
[*] The XP bar has been revamped.
[/olist]

notes.title: About the new update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. We saw that some bugs persisted after the last update and we quickly set to work to fix these bugs. We are currently still fixing bugs and testing. We need some more time. We read and know everything. We will fix all the bugs soon. 

You can get more involved in the process by joining our Discord server.

notes.title: PATCH NOTE 0.0.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979054/b6747071f5ea792fd51306d2c4513f24e089ca29.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

First of all, we would like to thank you, our valuable players, for your feedback and for all your positive and negative comments.

In this patch, we mainly focused on technical issues, economy, and bug fixes. We have fixed many bugs and made the game economy more balanced. Here are the patch notes:

----BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS----

-The issue of not being able to proceed to the end of the day has been fixed. You can now end the day even if there are still customers.
-The issue with placing some lights has been fixed.
-The issue with some product names being the same in French has been fixed.
Some sound issues have been fixed.
-The issue where the price on the checkout screen did not match the actual price of some products has been fixed.
-Some decoration errors in other stores have been fixed.
-The problem of items remaining at the checkout after paying for only one product in a group has been resolved.
-The issue of customers and cashiers remaining idle has been fixed.

----ECONOMY BALANCING AND IMPROVEMENTS---- 
We noticed that the game economy and balance were a bit difficult and unclear, so we worked on improving this. Here are the changes:

-Taxes have been reduced.
-The price of the cash register has been reduced from $2500 to $2000.
-The loan interest rate is now 2%.
-All license prices have been reduced.
-Bill expenses have been halved.
-Price tags now include warnings indicating whether the price of a product is high or very high. Remember, the higher the prices, the less likely customers are to buy.
-The market average prices of some products have been updated, and profit margins have been increased.

----GAMEPLAY CHANGES----

-Expired drugs can now be thrown away.
-If an AI is going to buy a product, the player can no longer take that product.
-All registers are now automatically closed when moving to the next day.
-When the store and register close, all customers who have not placed an order or purchased a product will leave the store.
-A stock system has been implemented, allowing you to see how many units of each product you have (by unit, not box).
-When placing products on shelves, an outline will now appear to indicate where the products will be placed.
-Everything except registers, computers, drugs, and other products can now be sold, and you will receive approximately half the purchase price (except for the height-weight scale, which will be addressed in the next update).
-The supplement and vitamin exams have been removed; they can now be purchased in the licenses section with money.
-The levels for supplementary products have been reduced: Baby care to level 8, dermo-cosmetics to 13, personal care to 14, and medical to level 16.


---Technical Improvements---

-A rare issue where save files were being deleted has been fixed, and precautions have been taken.


We thank you for your fantastic feedback. Your input and the motivation you give us continue to push this game forward. That's all for now in this patch, and we'll see you soon with new updates.

For support and communication: https://discord.gg/dqdEx3EH[img]

notes.title: About post-demo update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, first of all, we can consider this demo version as an open beta. We are aware of the existing bugs and are working to fix them. During the Steam Next Fest, we will continue to release updates and fix bugs. Right after the festival ends, we will release a new prologue version with additional features and updates based on the feedback from you, our valued players. Please let us know what you would like to see in this version here and on our Discord server.

[i][/i]Additionally, here are the plans for the post-festival version:

A user guide when starting the game.
An assistant for the cash register.
Performance improvements.
A few new mechanics.
Fixes for some level-related bugs.
Making the city more lively and giving the impression of a living city.
Changes in the decoration system, such as changing floor materials and reducing the time required for wall painting.
Adding new unique decoration materials.
And more.
Please get in touch with us and provide feedback. Let's build a great game together and enjoy the fun!
